name: dev
description: Runs the local development server at `http://127.0.0.1:8000/` with live watcher in **Dev Mode** (`releaseMode: false`).

name: toggle-mode
description: Flips `releaseMode` between `false` (Dev) and `true` (Release) in `data/settings.json` and rebuilds the site.

name: check-release
description: Inspects the committed Git tree (`HEAD`) to verify that the latest commit was created in Release Mode (`releaseMode: true`).

name: validate
description: Runs the automated integrity test suite (validates JSON databases, HTML content, internal routes, and local asset links).
